summary: Add a machine-checked tenant ownership and asynchronous execution inventory that rejects unclassified persistence and plugin execution boundaries.

changes: The shared package adds a versioned tenant persistence and timed plugin execution ownership registry plus a pooled-startup assertion.

notes: This change adds no database migration and does not alter existing PostgreSQL RLS policies.

security: CI fails when a TypeORM entity or selected asynchronous plugin execution boundary lacks an explicit tenant ownership classification.
The generated inventory records direct, inherited, pre-authentication, deployment-global, and plugin tenant-key boundaries without exposing tenant data.
knownLimitations: This inventory makes existing isolation boundaries explicit; later cloud-readiness slices add new RLS policies and runtime enforcement where the inventory identifies remaining application-enforced boundaries.
rollback: Remove the ownership manifests, generator, CI command, and documentation; no data or schema rollback is required.
validation: Run the ownership inventory contract tests and generator check.
Run release-note preflight, documentation-boundary validation, lint, and targeted pooled-tenancy tests.
